specs.desc: Woman in her early 40s, moderately broad soft square face with short rounded chin, high cheekbones and small eyes, solid dark short layered pixie haircut, jade casual bomber with thick black ribbed collar. Pose: torso turned AWAY toward left, HEAD ROTATED BACK over shoulder TOWARD RIGHT EDGE, visible LEFT ear on image left. Chin extends right of neck, shoulders sweep diagonally. Expression unmistakable spontaneous LAUGHTER: both eyes squeezed into upward-curving narrow crescents, cheeks raised, mouth clearly OPEN in wide asymmetrical smile, teeth ONE simple white band inside black mouth, no individual teeth or gums. Head tilted slightly backward in laughter. Shoulders cropped at upper chest. This should look like a candid moment, not model posing.
